# Day-ahead model (issue 10:00 on D-1): validation (generated by `scripts/run_dayahead.py`)

Git commit `02bae13e65`. Leads 14-37 h from the 10:00 origin; scenario A, same (day, hour) samples for all models. Samples: training 19,825, validation 4,367. MAE in MW. Hyper-parameters chosen on validation; early stopping on validation (mildly optimistic).

| model | validation MAE (MW) | MAPE % |
|---|---:|---:|
| naive: same hour on the latest earlier day | 5,536 | 2.84 |
| naive: same hour last week | 6,432 | 3.29 |
| ridge (full_abs, alpha 0.1) | 3,799 | 1.95 |
| XGBoost S4 (pooled) | 3,585 | 1.84 |
| LSTM L4 (pooled) | 3,867 | 1.98 |

Selected: ridge full_abs alpha 0.1; XGBoost best of 30 trials (trees [151, 91, 147]); LSTM new#16 (hidden 96, lr 0.004353, dropout 0.25, weight decay 0.00043), best epochs [5, 4, 4]; the stage-3 24 h configuration scored 4,075 MW under the same trial procedure.


Run time 2,845 s.
